claims.statement: The gate chain is defined in mise.toml: setup recreates the venv idempotently (uv venv --python 3.14 --clear plus editable install with dev extras), test runs pytest with -m "not live" and depends on setup, and live runs the live-marked tests explicitly.

pyproject.toml registers the live marker in [tool.pytest.ini_options] and pins asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function", silencing the pytest-asyncio deprecation warning that fires on every run even with zero async tests.

The unit gate is hermetic: 24 tests across tests/test_config.py and tests/test_project_ini.py cover config constants, cache-dir resolution, host-platform mapping (with skipif portability guard and a monkeypatched unsupported-pair ValueError test), and the full game.project editor contract (root resolution, compiled-path suffix, dependency forms and rewrites, include_dirs splitting, line preservation, CRLF byte-fidelity, injection guards) without network access or a JVM.

Byte-level assertions using write_bytes/read_bytes are used for the CRLF fidelity test on both fixture setup and assertion, because Path.read_text applies universal-newline conversion that would mask newline corruption.
